entity: Senate Banking Committee members' disproportionate share of bank-stock trades, 2012-20
what_we_add: The committee-wide numbers: 19% of trading senators, 34% of bank-stock trades
why: Salon and Daily Beast report heavy bank-stock trading by a Banking Committee member (Perdue) while on the committee — and the lead says Perdue alone drives the statistic, so the press has the substance. NBER's null result is about returns, a different measure, not a contradiction. The 19%/34% aggregate is ours.
